entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I hope you can help. I bought some things a while ago and I... I think I need to send something back. I'm just so confused by the website.
I can certainly help you look into that. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, um, yes, I think so. It's VF886-05. It's about the cycling shoes I ordered.
Okay, I see the order from 55 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?

I don't know... they just hurt. I tried them on a few rides and I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels. And I could never get the cleats to feel right. It's all so complicated. Can't you just help me?
Of course. I'm sorry to hear they're causing you discomfort; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've confirmed that your order is still well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with them. So I can get a refund?

Yes, absolutely. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once we receive them, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Wow, that's perfect. Thank you so much, Isaac. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
